title: Camera adapter manifest
description: Declarative identity/config for one camera adapter (see docs/CAMERA_ADAPTERS.md). Exactly one adapter is active per camera/archive at a time - this file is not a multi-adapter config, it's one adapter's own manifest. Fields this schema can't express (sidecar binary/text parsing, camera network protocol, config-snapshot parsing) are instead *named* in code_hooks_required and implemented by a small adapter class alongside this file.

adapter_id.description: Stable machine identifier, e.g. 'blackvue' or 'folder'. Matches the adapters/<adapter_id>/ directory this manifest lives in.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in UI/CLI, e.g. 'BlackVue dashcam'.

kind.description: What this adapter reads from. Future adapters may need more values (e.g. 'cloud_storage') - additions go here, not as a boolean explosion.

requires_network.description: If false, bv-download/bv-config's endpoint setup/bv-gps/bv-live are all inapplicable to this adapter - not degraded, simply not offered.

archive_layout.description: 'flat' = recordings live directly in the archive root (BlackVue's own convention). 'recursive' = recordings may be nested in subfolders (e.g. one folder per trip/date). This one flag is enough to pick the right generic scanner - it does not need to be adapter-specific code.

filename_pattern.description: Regex-based filename convention, or null if this adapter has no naming convention at all (see timestamp_source for the fallback in that case).

regex.description: Must define named groups 'date' and 'time' at minimum; 'kind' and 'direction' groups are optional (omit for adapters with no kind/direction vocabulary).

timestamp_format.description: strptime format string applied to the concatenated date+time groups.

id_group.description: Name of the regex group that is the recording id, or null if the whole match is the id.

timestamp_source.description: Ordered fallback chain for determining a recording's timestamp when filename_pattern is null or doesn't match a given file.

kind_vocabulary.description: The recording-kind letters this adapter's filename_pattern's 'kind' group can produce (BlackVue: Normal/Event/Manual/Parking/Unknown). An adapter with no kind concept still needs exactly one entry (a single default kind).

low_signal.description: Generalizes BlackVue's Parking mode: a long, low-information segment eligible for caps like max_parking_duration/--include-parking skip-and-replace. False for everything else.

default_included.description: Whether bv-download/bv-ls/bv-export include this kind by default without an explicit --mode filter.

direction_vocabulary.description: The camera-channel letters this adapter's filename_pattern's 'direction' group can produce (BlackVue: Front/Rear/Interior). An adapter with a single video track per recording still needs exactly one entry, marked primary.

primary.description: Exactly one direction must be primary=true - generalizes 'front video' as the reference track trip-building/--stitch/thumbnails default to.

asset_suffix_table.description: Ordered list mapping an on-disk filename suffix to an Asset identity. Order matters on suffix overlap (e.g. '.diarized.transcript.txt' must be listed before '.transcript.txt') - treat this as a first-match-wins list, not a set/dict.

asset.description: Name of an Asset enum member (src/blackvue/archive/asset.py). Camera-native assets (FRONT/REAR/GPS/...) are adapter-specific; generated assets (TRANSCRIPT/AUDIO/...) are shared across all adapters and don't need to be re-listed unless an adapter changes their suffix.

direction.description: One of direction_vocabulary's codes, if this asset belongs to a specific camera channel.

capabilities.description: What callers (CLI flags, bv-web UI sections) should check before offering a feature, instead of the feature silently no-op'ing or crashing on an unsupported adapter.

thumbnails.description: true = read from a camera-native sidecar, false = unavailable, 'generated' = synthesized on demand (e.g. an ffmpeg frame-grab).

code_hooks_required.description: Names of adapter-class methods/responsibilities this manifest cannot express declaratively and that must have real code behind them for this adapter to function (e.g. 'gps_sidecar_parser', 'camera_client').

gps_source_asset.description: Name of the Asset enum member (src/blackvue/archive/asset.py) whose on-disk file is handed to this adapter's read_gps(path) to get a recording's GPS fixes - null if capabilities.gps is false, or if this adapter simply has no GPS data. BlackVue: 'GPS' (a separate .gps sidecar file). A future adapter whose telemetry is embedded in the video itself instead of a sidecar (e.g. GoPro's GPMF stream) points this at that adapter's own video asset (e.g. 'FRONT') instead - read_gps() still just takes a path, it's simply the same file the video itself lives in.

gsensor_source_asset.description: Same as gps_source_asset, for read_gsensor(path). BlackVue: 'GSENSOR' (a separate .3gf sidecar file).

default_trip_gap_seconds.description: Fallback trip-gap threshold used when capabilities.config_snapshot is false (no per-recording nominal-segment-length source).

grouping_hint.description: 'subfolder' = recordings sharing an immediate parent folder are eligible to be grouped into the same trip before gap-based splitting still applies within it. Only meaningful when archive_layout is 'recursive'.

unsupported_notes.description: Human-readable list of features this adapter deliberately can't do and why - surfaced in UI/CLI help rather than left for the user to discover as an error.
